'''Flangolial''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] scientist and [[Darkwalkers|Darkwalker]] criminal who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Flangolial was the [[Chief Scientist/Legends|Chief of Science]] of the [[Darkwalkers|Darkwalker gang]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. She operated from a [[Darkwalker Cave (Dee'ja Peak)|cave]] near [[Dee'ja Peak/Legends|Dee'ja Peak]] with [[Bloodlord]] [[Trienial]].<ref name="SWG:RtsBS" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Trienial's group shot down a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] that crashed in the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]]. The Darkwalkers plundered the wreckage and stole a [[Bioscan/Legends|bio-scanner]].<ref name="SWG:FowtDtftCS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Find out what the Darkwalkers took from the Crashed Shuttle|Naboo}}</ref> Their objective was to use the bio-scanner to make a [[Bomb/Legends|bomb]] that would remain inert until its target with the programmed bio-signature came nearby. A spacer working with the scientist [[Tanoa Vills]] then raided the Darkwalker Cave to recover the stolen bio-scanner. Bloodlord Trienial and Flangolial were both killed during the assault.<ref name="SWG:RtsBS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Flangolial was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RtsBS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Flangolialk was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]],"<ref name="SWG:RtsBS" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
